units.source_text: 源氏便问内大臣的儿子弁少将：“我不知道是从哪里听来的，总之，有人告诉我说：

en.t: Genji then asked Ben no Shosho, the son of the Minister of the Interior, “I do not know where I heard it, but in any case someone told me this:

units.source_text: 你家内大臣最近找到了一个外边妇人所生的女儿，正在用心教养她。

en.t: your Minister of the Interior has recently found a daughter born to a woman outside the household, and is taking great pains to bring her up.

units.source_text: 真有其事么？”

en.t: Is that really true?”

units.source_text: 弁少将答道：“有的，不过没有像外间传说那么夸张。

en.t: Ben no Shosho replied, “It is true, but not as exaggerated as people outside are saying.

units.source_text: 今年春天父亲做了一个梦，叫人来详。

en.t: This spring my father had a dream and summoned someone to interpret it.

units.source_text: 有一个女子听到了这件事，自己前来投靠，说她正是有恨欲诉之人。

en.t: A woman heard about this and came of her own accord to seek his protection, saying that she was the very person who had a grievance to tell.

units.source_text: 我哥哥柏木中将闻知了，便去调查，到底是真是假，有否确实证据。

en.t: My elder brother, Lieutenant General Kashiwagi, heard of it and went to investigate whether it was true or false and whether there was any solid proof.

units.source_text: 详细情况我不知道。

en.t: I do not know the details.

units.source_text: 近来世人都把此事当作一件珍闻传述呢。

en.t: Lately everyone has been passing the matter around as a curious piece of news.

units.source_text: 此种事情，对我父亲说来，自然是家庭的一点瑕疵。”

en.t: For my father, naturally, such a thing is a small blemish on the family.”

units.source_text: 源氏听了，知道确有其事，便接着说道：“你父亲有了这么许多子女，还要用心去寻找这一只离群之雁，也太贪心了。

en.t: Hearing this, Genji knew the matter was indeed true, and went on, “Your father already has so many children, yet he still takes pains to search for this one stray goose; he is far too greedy.

units.source_text: 我家子女稀少，颇想找到这样的人，大约其人不屑来投靠我吧，一点消息也没有。

en.t: In my household children are few, and I would very much like to find such a person, but perhaps she would not deign to come to me; I have had no word at all.

units.source_text: 我看，既然前来投靠，总不是全无关系的。

en.t: In my view, if she has come seeking protection, she cannot be entirely unrelated.

units.source_text: 你父亲年轻时代，到处乱钻，不择高下。

en.t: When your father was young, he slipped in everywhere without choosing high or low.

units.source_text: 好比一个月亮，映在不清澄的水里，哪得不模糊呢？”

en.t: It is like a single moon reflected in murky water; how could it help but appear blurred?”

units.source_text: 说时脸上显出微笑。

en.t: As he said this, a smile appeared on his face.

units.source_text: 夕雾详知内大臣最近找到的女儿近江君品貌不佳，所以他父亲用这比喻来暗示，他一向态度严肃，此时亦不免失笑。

en.t: Yugiri knew well that Omi no Kimi, the daughter recently found by the Minister of the Interior, was lacking in looks and manners, so when his father hinted at it with this comparison, even he, usually so serious, could not help laughing.

units.source_text: 弁少将和他的弟弟藤侍从觉得很不自在。

en.t: Ben no Shosho and his younger brother To no Jiju felt extremely uncomfortable.

units.source_text: 源氏又同夕雾开玩笑：“夕雾啊，你就拾了这一张落叶吧。

en.t: Genji then joked with Yugiri again: “Yugiri, you should pick up this fallen leaf.

units.source_text: 与其遭人拒绝，长被世人所取笑，还不如折了这同根之枝，聊以自慰，有何不可呢？”

en.t: Rather than be rejected by others and long laughed at by the world, why not break off this branch from the same root and take a little comfort in it?”
